title: Dragon Mage on Mystic Path
description: A female warrior with purple braided hair stands on a winding golden path, holding a glowing staff in one hand and a large pink lotus flower in the other. Behind her, a massive green serpentine dragon with intricate patterns coils around a swirling vortex containing a crescent moon, set against a stylized night cityscape with floating magical orbs and celestial symbols.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with long purple braided hair wearing dark armored clothing stands on a cracked golden path. She holds a glowing magical staff with blue energy in one hand and a giant pink lotus flower in the other. In the background, a large ornate green dragon coils around a swirling vortex with a yellow crescent moon inside. Stylized green city buildings with glowing windows fill the night sky along with floating pink orbs, crescent moons, and magical symbols.
